segments.text: Guys, I screwed up. I spent millions of dollars trying to not die, and I just found mold in my gym. The air in this room had 4,900 mold spores per cubic meter. That is more than 13 times the air outside. So, we're tearing it all out and doing a full rebuild. Over 90% of the mold spores we found were Penicillium and Aspergillus. These molds can drive airway inflammation, worsen asthma and allergies, and some of these species produce mycotoxins, which are systemically toxic and carcinogenic.

Just what you want when you're gasping for air in between sets. Now, thankfully, I test for mold periodically. So, we caught this spike before any detectable health damage. Studies show that nearly 50% of US homes have dampness or mold issues, and most go undetected. We're going to rebuild my gym using the best materials for mold prevention and document what we learn in the process. Follow along for mold protocols. Not to get it, you know, to find it and then get rid of it.
